mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 signals robust demand growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not exceed +1.5% in 3 out of 5 instances where GDPC1 growth is positive, or if GDPC1 growth turns negative in the subsequent quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in UNRATE below 5.0% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it signals labor market strengthening.
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to exceed +1.2% in 4 out of 5 instances where UNRATE crosses below 5.0%, or if returns are negative despite the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Co-movement between quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and household spending (HOUST) above trend levels signals strong demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not rise above baseline when both proxies are above their 12-month averages, or if their correlation falls below 0.7.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.0% during a tightening cycle triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher interest rates compress equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day returns fail to decline by 1.5% in 4 out of 5 instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or if returns remain positive despite the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO above 106.0 indicates robust supply growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns do not rise by 1.0% in 3 out of 5 instances where INDPRO growth is positive, or if growth turns negative.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in INDPRO above 106.0 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as it signals unexpected supply expansion.
failure_condition: 5-day returns fail to exceed +0.5% in 4 out of 5 instances where INDPRO crosses above 106.0, or if returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment rates (UNRATE) signal a robust labor market, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not exceed +1.0% when both proxies meet the trigger, or if their correlation drops below 0.8.

mechanism_narrative: A late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 17000) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 238) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns fail to rise by 1.5% in 4 out of 5 instances where the regime conditions are met, or if other variables like inflation dominate the signal.
